window-1.title: net-art.org — Collaborative
window-1.blurb: A whole index of net art that only exists because strangers keep showing up to add to it — exactly your kind of internet, and I fully expect you to end up building your own by Sunday.

window-2.title: Cool but not “cool cool” — Kiko Mizuhara on Blackbird Spyplane
window-2.blurb: Spyplane at its goofiest and most obsessive, interviewing a Tokyo shapeshifter who acts, models, and designs — basically your side-quest energy in interview form.

window-3.title: Red Shiso Mocktail
window-3.blurb: Red shiso steeps into a shocking electric-magenta that flips color the second citrus hits it, so you get a drink that's half herbal Japanese summer, half chemistry-set party trick — fully worth the photo.

window-4.title: Ignant — Interiors & Home Visits
window-4.blurb: It's a rolling feed of real people's homes — the kind stacked with books, odd ceramics and lamps with a story — and you'll want to rearrange your whole living room within ten minutes of scrolling.

window-5.title: Miura, Joo Chiat
window-5.blurb: You have to walk through a three-storey Joo Chiat shophouse full of independent labels before you find this tiny matcha-and-wagashi counter hiding at the back, which makes getting a daifuku feel like a small side quest you completed.
